evidence.V1: Front view reads as a low berry bush mound; from top and three-quarter the clover-lobed blob reads more like a pepper or slime, and the silhouette is a soft lump with berry bumps.
evidence.V2: Big mound and small berries are present, but the medium tier (individual puffs) is mushy: lobes melt into each other with no defined clusters.
evidence.V3: Lobes are low and swollen with no lift or crown; proportion reads as a melted dome rather than a confident stylised bush.
evidence.V4: Fused smooth shell is soft everywhere; puff boundaries are vague creases, berries are low-poly with visible faceting, so edge definition is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Studio close-ups show a faint triangle-grid mottling across the puff surfaces and a soft crease seam down the centre where lobes fuse; minor but visible.
evidence.V6: One foliage hue in 2-3 values with gold berries as the single accent; colourways (autumn, blossom) keep the same discipline.
evidence.V7: 1688 tris vs medium target 2000 - under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, fused smooth organic shell and gold accent per the Nature spec.
evidence.V9: Studio line: foliage flags (Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box), MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.
